question: Can one App resolve a review thread opened by another App or by a third-party reviewer?
pass: Written 2026-10-29, before window 3 ran (runbook-window-3, issue 389): the queue App, its permissions narrowed to contents: write and metadata: read alone, resolves a thread CodeRabbit opened, a person's and the trial-author App's, each reading back resolved, its resolvedBy typed with login, databaseId and __typename. On canary pull request 70, a person's: a person's thread and two of the trial-author App's (its comment step ran twice, by mistake). The queue App, narrowed as written, resolved all three, each answered with no error, each read back resolved by combsmith-sf-queue[bot], a User by __typename, databaseId 349593770. CodeRabbit's thread was not had: its free reviews were rate limited for the window, so its case stays with P-5's first run (trials/P-5.json), where an App resolved another App's thread with contents: write. Passed for the queue App on every thread it had.
